notes: This paper uses black hole superradiance to constrain the string theory landscape (fraction of excluded Calabi-Yau manifolds vs Hodge number). The exclusions are in the (axion mass m_a, self-interaction/decay constant f_pert) plane, not on a standard coupling like g_agamma, g_ae, etc. Fig 2 shows exclusion functions in (m_a, lambda^-1 or f_pert), but this is a self-interaction (quartic coupling) bound, which does not map to any of the provided enum coupling types. No extractable standard coupling-vs-mass limit.
